name: Lost in Shadows
source:
Sirius, king and ruler of the demon realm, after being betrayed by his adviser, is used as a guinea pig for his tests on ancient spells. One day, after a failure in the mana isolation system, a dangerous spell is unleashed, directly hitting Sirius and making him disappear, without a trace...

This is a story that tells the events of a long time ago, far away from here. A kinetic novel, the result of a troubled mind full of thoughts...

[From [url=https://yellow-chocobo.itch.io/lost-in-shadows]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
小天狼星，恶魔领域的国王和统治者，在被他的顾问背叛后，被用作测试古代咒语的小白鼠。有一天，法力隔离系统故障后，一个危险的法术被释放，直接击中小天狼星，让他消失得无影无踪……

这是一个故事，讲述了很久以前，远离这里的事件。一部充满动感的小说，一个充满思想的困扰心灵的结果……

[来自[url=https://yellow-chocobo.itch.io/lost-in-shadows]Itch.io[/url]]
